    GLOBAL HEALTHCARE MANAGEMENT COLLEGE

    Global Healthcare Management College is dedicated to empowering students with vocational education and training programs that support their professional growth and career aspirations. Our focus is on delivering top-notch training and assessment services that equip learners with nationally recognised qualifications and statements of attainment in allied health and management. Our goal is to provide students with the skills and knowledge necessary to succeed in their chosen fields, ensuring they are equipped to excel in today’s competitive job market.

    • Offers vocational education and training programs.
    • Provides certified health and management qualifications.
    • Equips students with skills for career success.
    • Prepares students for today’s competitive job market.

    Begin Your Learning Adventure

    Start your journey of growth and discovery with courses that unlock your potential

    Graduate Diploma of Management (Learning)

    This qualification may apply to leaders and managers in an organisation where learning is used to build organisational capability. The job roles that relate to this qualification may also include RTO Manager and RTO Director.

    $18,000

    Enroll Now
    • 62 Weeks

    Certificate III in Individual Support : CHC33021

    This qualification reflects the role of individuals in the community, home or residential care setting who work under supervision and delegation as a part of a multi-disciplinary team, following an individualised plan.

    $15,000

    Enroll Now
    • 104 Weeks

    Diploma of Community Services : CHC52021

    This qualification reflects the role of community services workers involved in the delivery, management and coordination of person-centred services to individuals, groups, and communities.

    $23,000
